    • setOrdinaryKeyformPositions

      @CubismEditor(from="5.0.00") default void setOrdinaryKeyformPositions(WarpAuthoringSnapshot expected, List<WarpKeyformPositions> edits)
      Compare-and-set controls in existing non-default ordinary forms, in one authoring operation. Complete GUID coordinates and independent stored form identities are required. Grid dimensions, default form, bindings and other forms are preserved.

    • morphSnapshot

      @CubismEditor(from="5.0.00") default WarpMorphSnapshot morphSnapshot()
      Detached neutral Warp geometry and opacity blend shapes. Ordinary axes and extended interpolation are excluded.

    • createOpacityMorphKeyform

      @CubismEditor(from="5.0.00") default void createOpacityMorphKeyform(ParameterId parameterId, float keyValue, float absoluteOpacity)
      Creates one absolute opacity key for a blend parameter with default zero. Requires a neutral Warp with one ordinary base form and no constraints or extended interpolation. The key must be nonzero and within the parameter range. Duplicate keys within the host snap tolerance are rejected. Parent deformers are allowed. Controls, base opacity and parameter values are preserved. The operation participates in the active authoring transaction and its Undo group.

    • createMorphKeyform

      @CubismEditor(from="5.0.00") default void createMorphKeyform(ParameterId parameterId, float keyValue, List<Point2> absoluteControlPoints)
      Creates an absolute control-point blend key on a neutral Warp with no ordinary axes. The blend parameter default must be zero. Parent deformers are allowed. Controls must match the current grid. All other stored forms and parameter values are preserved.
